review_comment: The code directly logs validation error details (invalidReason) to console without sanitization or access control. This exposes sensitive internal state information that could aid attackers in understanding transaction validation logic. Remove the console.log statement and ensure no sensitive data is written to debug logs.

The code includes raw exception details in error reporting which can expose internal system information. The patch introduces direct inclusion of e.message without sanitization, creating potential for information disclosure. Consider sanitizing or filtering exception messages before including them in invalidReason to prevent exposure of internal implementation details.
